'''''Encyclopedia of Mathematics''''' is a 2005 encyclopedic [[reference work]] by Australian–American mathematician [[James Tanton]] that was published by Facts-on-File of New York.<ref>{{cite news|title=Teacher Makes Mathematics Accessible; Bagels, Laundry Become Tools for Learning|url=https://pqasb.pqarchiver.com/boston/access/826509301.html?FMT=ABS&FMTS=ABS:FT&type=current&date=Apr+24%2C+2005&author=&pub=Boston+Globe&desc=TEACHER+MAKES+MATHEMATICS+ACCESSIBLE+%3B+BAGELS%2C+LAUNDRY+BECOME+TOOLS+FOR+LEARNING&pqatl=google|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130131231822/http://pqasb.pqarchiver.com/boston/access/826509301.html?FMT=ABS&FMTS=ABS:FT&type=current&date=Apr+24,+2005&author=&pub=Boston+Globe&desc=TEACHER+MAKES+MATHEMATICS+ACCESSIBLE+;+BAGELS,+LAUNDRY+BECOME+TOOLS+FOR+LEARNING&pqatl=google|url-status=dead|archive-date=January 31, 2013|accessdate=21 August 2012|newspaper=Boston Globe|date=Apr 24, 2005}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|title=Sci-tech news, Volume 60, Issues 1-4|year = 2006|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=2gThAAAAMAAJ&q=%22Encyclopedia+of+Mathematics%22+Tanton|publisher=Special Libraries Association. Science-Technology Division|accessdate=21 August 2012}}</ref>

==Synopsis==
The book has over 1000 entries, which discuss various concepts, definitions, [[Lists of mathematicians|people]], and [[Mathematical theorem|theorems]] that pertain to [[mathematics]]. The book also contains six [[essay]]s that discuss the various [[branches of mathematics]] and their [[History of mathematics|history]].

==Reception==
[[Booklist]] praised the book as a useful "basic resource for students who wish to have a better understanding of simple or not-so--simple mathematical concepts" and the ''[[School Library Journal]]'' called the encyclopedia "comprehensive".<ref>{{cite web|title=Review: Encyclopedia of Mathematics|url=http://www.booklistonline.com/Encyclopedia-of-Mathematics-James-Tanton/pid=1513094|publisher=Booklist|accessdate=21 August 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last=Ostergard|first=Maren|title=Reference Books|url=http://www.schoollibraryjournal.com/article/CA6287969.html|publisher=School Library Journal|accessdate=21 August 2012}}</ref>
